import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.Collectors;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            Circle[] circles = new Circle[n];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                String[] parts = br.readLine().split("\\s+");
                int x = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
                int y = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
                int r = Integer.parseInt(parts[2]);
                circles[i] = new Circle(x, y, r);
            }

            Set<Point> all = new TreeSet<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = i + 1; j < n; j++) {
                    List<Point> inter = intersect(circles[i], circles[j]);
                    if (inter != null) all.addAll(inter);
                }
            }

            Map<Point, Integer> pointId = new HashMap<>();
            List<Set<Integer>> adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                List<Double> angles = new ArrayList<>();
                final int K = 100;
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    angles.add(Math.PI * 2 * j / K);
                }
                for (Point p : all) {
                    if (circles[i].contains(p)) {
                        double dx = p.x - circles[i].x;
                        double dy = p.y - circles[i].y;
                        double alpha = Math.atan2(dy, dx);
                        if (alpha < 0) alpha += 2 * Math.PI;
                        angles.add(alpha);
                    }
                }
                Collections.sort(angles);
                Point dir = new Point(circles[i].r, 0);
                Double[] as = new TreeSet<>(angles).toArray(new Double[0]);
                for (int j = 0; j < as.length; j++) {
                    Point p = circles[i].center().add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
                    getId(p, pointId, adj);
                }
                for (int j = 0; j < as.length; j++) {
                    Point p = circles[i].center().add(dir.rotate(as[j]));
                    Point q = circles[i].center().add(dir.rotate(as[(j + 1) % as.length]));
                    int u = pointId.get(p);
                    int v = pointId.get(q);
                    if (u != v) {
                        adj.get(u).add(v);
                        adj.get(v).add(u);
                    }
                }
            }

            int v = adj.size();
            int e = 0;
            for (Set<Integer> s : adj) e += s.size();
            e /= 2;

            int comps = 0;
            boolean[] was = new boolean[v];
            for (int i = 0; i < v; i++) {
                if (!was[i]) {
                    ++comps;
                    dfs(i, was, adj);
                }
            }

            pw.println(1 + comps + e - v);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    private void dfs(int i, boolean[] was, List<Set<Integer>> adj) {
        was[i] = true;
        for (int j : adj.get(i)) {
            if (!was[j]) dfs(j, was, adj);
        }
    }

    private void getId(Point p, Map<Point, Integer> pointId, List<Set<Integer>> adj) {
        if (!pointId.containsKey(p)) {
            int sz = pointId.size();
            pointId.put(p, sz);
            adj.add(new TreeSet<>());
        }
    }

    private List<Point> intersect(Circle c1, Circle c2) {
        double dx = c1.x - c2.x;
        double dy = c1.y - c2.y;
        double d = Math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        double cos = (c1.r * c1.r + d * d - c2.r * c2.r) / (2 * c1.r * d);
        if (cos < -1 - 1e-8 || cos > 1 + 1e-8) return null;
        if (cos < -1) cos = -1;
        if (cos > 1) cos = 1;
        List<Point> res = new ArrayList<>();
        double alpha = Math.acos(cos);
        Point dir = new Point(c2.x - c1.x, c2.y - c1.y).norm();
        res.add(c1.center().add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(alpha)));
        res.add(c1.center().add(dir.scale(c1.r).rotate(-alpha)));
        return res;
    }

    static class Point implements Comparable<Point> {
        double x, y;
        static final double eps = 1e-8;

        Point(double x, double y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }

        Point add(Point o) {
            return new Point(x + o.x, y + o.y);
        }

        Point sub(Point o) {
            return new Point(x - o.x, y - o.y);
        }

        Point rotate(double alpha) {
            double c = Math.cos(alpha), s = Math.sin(alpha);
            return new Point(x * c - y * s, x * s + y * c);
        }

        Point norm() {
            double len = length();
            return scale(1.0 / len);
        }

        Point scale(double f) {
            return new Point(f * x, f * y);
        }

        double length() {
            return Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y);
        }

        public String toString() {
            return String.format("%.6f %.6f", x, y);
        }

        public boolean equals(Object obj) {
            Point o = (Point) obj;
            return Math.abs(x - o.x) < eps && Math.abs(y - o.y) < eps;
        }

        public int compareTo(Point o) {
            if (Math.abs(x - o.x) > eps) return x < o.x ? -1 : 1;
            if (Math.abs(y - o.y) > eps) return y < o.y ? -1 : 1;
            return 0;
        }

        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(Double.doubleToLongBits(x / eps), Double.doubleToLongBits(y / eps));
        }
    }

    static class Circle {
        int x, y, r;

        Circle(int x, int y, int r) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
            this.r = r;
        }

        Point center() {
            return new Point(x, y);
        }

        boolean contains(Point p) {
            double dist = p.sub(center()).length();
            return Math.abs(dist - r) < 1e-8;
        }
    }
}
